migration_plan_review: two additional reproduced foundation defects. - P1: ComponentInstance properties are only shallow Readonly

. Nested writes and array.push compile with zero diagnostics although stored values are frozen; require recursively readonly reads and exact compiler rejection cases. - P2: after a branch reads a new missing dependency then throws, only previous dependencies remain tracked. Creating the missing component emits no recovery event (events stay 1), though manual read recovers; retain new failed-read dependencies until success. Read-only TypeScript probes reproduced both against rebuilt output. Foundation acceptance remains pending these corrections.
